description: Move a billing project to a different customer within your organization. Both the project and the destination customer must belong to your organization. Requires Manager role or above.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

new_customer_id.description: ID of the destination customer (required, must belong to your organization).

project_id.description: ID of the project to move (required).

name: move_project
